# Stickyy 1.2.10
## Stickyy Timer
- Set a timer for up to 60 minutes from the menu-bar scratchpad or floating note. - The compact timer icon smoothly expands into a live countdown pill. - A sound and macOS attention request let you know when time is up. - Stickyy sends a local notification when the timer finishes, including while another app is in front. - When both note windows are closed, the regular menu-bar icon smoothly turns into a live Liquid Timer pill. Opening either note restores the regular icon. - The menu-bar pill now returns to the normal icon before the scratchpad opens, keeping its popover arrow perfectly aligned. - A completed timer turns green in the note header; click it once to reset it to the compact timer icon. - Hide Stickyy Timer completely from Settings whenever you prefer a more minimal workspace.
## Smoother Clipboard Pills
- Clipboard Pills now respond freely to horizontal trackpad gestures. - Vertical mouse-wheel movement over the shelf is translated into horizontal scrolling, making every pill easier to reach.
## Numbered lists
- Begin a line with `1. ` and press Return to continue with `2.`, `3.`, and onward. - Press Return on an empty numbered item to finish the list.
## A more complete welcome
- Onboarding now introduces the Liquid Timer. - A final feature grid highlights Multiple Notes, pinned notes, text formatting, and chapter sections. - The startup card now simply says that Stickyy is back in the menu bar.
Existing Stickyy users can install this release from **Check for Updates**. The direct-download DMG remains a free Apple Development-signed test build and is not Apple-notarized. First-time users may need to approve Stickyy in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** before opening it.
